identity: New EEGMAT adaptation with an official pretrained CBraMod backbone; not BrainPEC downstream replication
task: background versus mental arithmetic, not clinical stress or depression

windows.selection: evenly spaced full windows, both conditions retained

representation.pool: mean across channels and time patches

head.selection: validation balanced accuracy; ties prefer smaller C

probe.features: first two entries in each of six official registry families, 12 entries/62 columns
probe.selection: per-feature-group mean validation R2; ties prefer smaller alpha
probe.metric: raw unclipped column R2; constant train columns excluded and counted
probe.negative_control: seeded participant-block derangement PLUS independent row permutation within destination blocks, destroying condition/window alignment; verify every active target column changes; diagnostic randomized-target control, not a permutation significance test; no test target fitting

interventions.selection: top two distinct feature groups by their best validation mean R2 across the two layers; no task accuracy selection
interventions.basis: SVD of fitted linear-probe directions, numerical rank tolerance 1e-8
interventions.operation: subtract pooled learned-subspace component as the same shift at every activation token, then run all remaining frozen layers and the frozen head
interventions.controls: 3 seeded random subspaces with identical actual rank and exactly matched per-window shift norm
interventions.residual_recovery: refit probes on altered training representations; select alpha using altered validation representations only

uncertainty.multiplicity: Q1 family is all 24 feature-layer groups, additionally report Bonferroni-adjusted bootstrap intervals at 1-0.05/24; Q2 selected-family size 2, adjusted intervals 97.5%; approximation noted with only six final-test subjects
uncertainty.primary_Q2_contrast: change in balanced accuracy versus mean change across three rank/strength-matched random controls

interpretation: recoverability does not establish prediction reliance
representation intervention does not establish physiological causation
negative task effects and null findings are retained
45 Hz/30 Hz metadata conflicts require EDF-header evidence; high-frequency conclusions remain qualified
single small dataset and six held-out subjects cannot establish clinical generalization
test_policy: Only after fitted parameters, choices, code and this protocol are hash frozen. One trusted reference evaluation; further independent replay is audit only, never new selection.
